meta.description: Mixed crop-livestock, 1000–1800m. Enset farming, high erosion.

data_sources.soil: SoilGrids v2.0 — ISRIC REST API (shallowest depth ~0-5cm)
data_sources.dem: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 100m EPSG:32637 — Planetary Computer
data_sources.modis_lpi: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 250m EPSG:32637 — Planetary Computer
data_sources.chirps: CHIRPS v2.0 2014–2023 annual TIFs — CHC UCSB /vsicurl/
data_sources.era5: ERA5-Land 2023 via Open-Meteo historical-forecast-api (free, no credentials)

community_intelligence.community_preferred_future: Improve food security; reduce soil erosion; access markets for surplus crops
community_intelligence.local_degradation_memory: Crop yields reported down 30-40% over 20 years; severe rill formation on all hillsides since 2005
community_intelligence.grazing_rules: Open grazing on communal hilltops and fallow; little formal regulation
community_intelligence.labor_constraints: Youth out-migration to Addis and Hawassa; women and elderly bear most farm work
community_intelligence.gendered_burdens: Women: full crop production burden plus fuelwood (3h/day) plus water fetching (1.5h/day)
community_intelligence.youth_opportunities: Terrace construction brigades, compost enterprise, improved seed distribution agents
community_intelligence.local_conflict_risks: Competition over degraded communal grazing land between households
community_intelligence.tenure_constraints: Households have formal holdings but steepland often informally occupied
